scientific_integrity: The new claim is restricted to the specified characteristic-three Fermat quartic, the 48 classical and 64 excess embedded lines, and rational Picard span. The prior 112-line theorem, classical 48-line formula, and supersingular rank 22 are attributed, not claimed as new. Independent assessment has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: No integral Picard-lattice index or saturation theorem.
Computational exactness uses published geometric completeness and K3 intersection theorems.
Historical-priority uncertainty remains for auxiliary line-coordinate tables and earlier unindexed analyses.
title: The sixty-four excess lines on the characteristic-three Fermat quartic form a rank-twenty-one lattice
